panels.title: P-state
panels.description: Najbardziej aktywny stan wydajności w przedziale: P0 to pełna wydajność, P8 i wyżej to oszczędzanie energii.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (sampled_at / 1000 / MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000)) * MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000) AS time, 'P' || MIN(CAST(substr(pstate, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS `P-state` FROM gpu_samples WHERE sampled_at >= $__from AND sampled_at < $__to AND pstate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT (sampled_at / 1000 / MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000)) * MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000) AS time, 'P' || MIN(CAST(substr(pstate, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS `P-state` FROM gpu_samples WHERE sampled_at >= $__from AND sampled_at < $__to AND pstate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Procesy na GPU
panels.description: Procesy liczące na GPU w ostatniej próbce wybranego zakresu. Procesy graficzne (np. Xorg) nie są tu raportowane przez nvidia-smi.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT p.pid AS PID, p.name AS Proces, p.vram_used_mb AS `VRAM [MiB]` FROM gpu_processes p WHERE p.sampled_at = (SELECT MAX(s.sampled_at) FROM gpu_samples s WHERE s.sampled_at >= $__from AND s.sampled_at < $__to) ORDER BY p.vram_used_mb DESC, p.pid
targets.queryText: SELECT p.pid AS PID, p.name AS Proces, p.vram_used_mb AS `VRAM [MiB]` FROM gpu_processes p WHERE p.sampled_at = (SELECT MAX(s.sampled_at) FROM gpu_samples s WHERE s.sampled_at >= $__from AND s.sampled_at < $__to) ORDER BY p.vram_used_mb DESC, p.pid

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (sampled_at / 1000 / MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000)) * MAX(1, ${__interval_ms} / 1000) AS time, name AS proces, MAX(vram_used_mb) AS value FROM gpu_processes WHERE sampled_at >= $__from AND sampled_at < $__to GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
